Welcome to {set:company}! Your coach is {col:clients.coach} and your goal is {col:clients.goal}. Your current package is {col:clients.cur_pack}.
Please arrive ten minutes early, wear comfortable clothes and bring water. Tell your coach about any injury, medicine or change in your health at every session.
A session moved in good time costs nothing. A session cancelled late or missed uses one session from your package.
Before your first session please sign the health questionnaire and the waiver. They stay valid for {set:par_days} days and we will remind you before they end.
We are glad to have you with us. Message us any time with questions.
This agreement is made on {col:memberships.start} between {set:company} and {col:memberships.name} (the client).

1. Package: {col:memberships.package}, with {col:memberships.sessions} sessions, valid from {col:memberships.start} to {col:memberships.end}. Sessions not used by the end date lapse, unless the package is frozen as described below.

2. Price: the list price is {col:memberships.price} and the price after the agreed discount ({col:memberships.why}) is {col:memberships.net}. Payment is due on the start date; payments more than {set:grace} days after it are late.
3. Moving sessions: a session moved or cancelled in good time is not lost. A no-show or a late cancellation uses one session.
4. Freezing: the package can be frozen for up to {set:freeze_max} days for travel, illness or injury. The end date moves by the days frozen.
5. Health: the client confirms the health questionnaire is true and will tell the coach about any change before training.
6. Ending early: any refund is worked out on the sessions actually used, as set out in the studio policy.

Open Start and type your studio name and your rules in the yellow cells: renewal window, low sessions, grace days, largest discount, freeze limit and consent validity.
